authority_note: Producer (orchestrator) never verifies; directive-compliance-verifier owns verification rows. All D-045 requirements bind the non-ledger sentinel D-045-BOOTSTRAP (D-038..D-043 precedent; validator c5 forbids sentinel task_ids in task_verifications). Tasks contracted under this campaign cite D-045:<requirement ids> and verify through their own DCV rows in the usual way; directive-level requirements remain OPEN until their coverage is actually accepted - no completion claim exists at capture time.
